Temporal ledger task v1. Entity IDs are authoritative; display labels may repeat.
WRITE and DELETE increment the revision of exactly one (entity ID, key) slot.
supersedes identifies the previous mutation of that slot. DELETE leaves a tombstone.
RECALL quotes an earlier WRITE; it never changes state, even if printed later.
The ledger token None means no reference or revision.
At a cutoff, consider only mutations at positions less than or equal to that cutoff.
A state query selects the highest eligible revision. A revision query selects exactly
the requested revision, even if later revisions exist. Never follow a display label.
If the selected mutation is DELETE answer [DELETED]; if no eligible mutation exists
answer [UNSET]. Otherwise copy its value. Return JSON with status, value, event_id,
revision. Status is present/deleted/unset. Value is null for deleted/unset; event_id
and revision are null only for unset. Use the selected mutation as provenance.
